microvm-custom-domains.//1: EDIT THESE VALUES, then `npx cdk deploy`. All are overridable with -c.
microvm-custom-domains.//zone: Existing Route 53 public hosted zone that will hold the wildcard record.
microvm-custom-domains.//domain: The wildcard base under which each <uuid> custom domain is served.
microvm-custom-domains.//origin: The MicroVM GA endpoint domain requests are rewritten TO. The label before this base (the MicroVM id) is preserved per-request by the Host rewrite regex.
microvm-custom-domains.//privatelink: AWS-managed PrivateLink service for reaching MicroVMs privately (public com.amazonaws.<region>.<svc> name; safe to commit).
microvm-custom-domains.//cors: Value for the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header the ALB inserts on every response. '*' for the demo.
microvm-custom-domains.//image: ARN of the MicroVM image the provisioning Lambda launches when no running MicroVM is available.
microvm-custom-domains.//app: Single host (a label under customDomainBase) that serves the demo page AND its /api/provision endpoint from one ALB-invoked Lambda. Covered by the wildcard cert/record; matched ahead of the host-rewrite rule.
